item.tib: pra mo ha yi brda' tshig
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ ma mkha' 'gro dang mjal ba'i brda tshig yin/ sprang shig gis zos pa'i nyams snang yin/ grogs po rnams kyis bskul ba'i dris lan yin/ gzigs skyes mchog nang gi drung du 'bul/ don grogs po rnams kyis gsal 'debs mdzod/ 'thad na grogs mchog thugs la zhogs/ mi 'thad thugs khrel mi gnang zhu/ ma mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol//
